### 2.4 Non-Functional Requirements
*(How the system must behave — often dropped if not asked for explicitly)*

| ID | Category | Requirement | Measurable Target |
|---|---|---|---|
| NFR-01 | Performance | {e.g. Checkout API response time} | {p95 < 200ms} |
| NFR-02 | Security | {e.g. Password storage} | {bcrypt/argon2, never plaintext} |
| NFR-03 | Usability | {e.g. Mobile responsiveness} | {Usable on 360px width viewport} |
| NFR-04 | Availability | {e.g. Uptime target} | {99.5% monthly} |

### 2.5 Transition Requirements

| ID | Requirement | Type | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|
| TR-01 | {e.g. Migrate 3 years of historical invoices from legacy DB} | Data migration | {Owner} |
| TR-02 | {e.g. Train finance team on new reconciliation flow} | Training | {Owner} |
| TR-03 | {e.g. Run legacy + new system in parallel for 2 weeks} | Cutover | {Owner} |
